name: Sealed Secrets
author: Sextant
description: Bitnami Sealed Secrets: SealedSecrets with the controller's Synced state and its error in plain words, the scope they were sealed for, the target Secret and how it stands (from its metadata only), the sealed keys by name and size, and the controller with its sealing keys (metadata only; the certificate is never read); opt-in problems of failed unseals. Read-only, and never a value, sealed or decrypted.
